tasks.title: Add the npm verify script used as the gate of every task
acceptance: package.json has a `verify` script that runs, in this order and stopping at the first failure: `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run knip`, `npm test`, `npm run build`
docs/development-workflow.md names `npm run verify` as the gate and lists the five steps; the sentence saying the script does not exist yet is removed
tasks.notes: Harness self-test: small, real and safe. Run it as the first loop dry run.

tasks.title: Run the Playwright smoke tests on their own port and build directory
acceptance: playwright.config.ts takes the port from one constant set to 3100 and the base URL from it; `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL` in its dummy env follows the constant
the web server is never reused locally: `reuseExistingServer` is false, so a server on 3100 that the run did not start fails the run instead of being tested

the e2e build and server use a separate Next build directory `.next-e2e`: next.config.mjs reads `distDir` from `NEXT_DIST_DIR` (default `.next`) and the Playwright web server sets `NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-e2e`; `next start` serves on the constant port
`.next-e2e/` is ignored by git, ESLint, Prettier and knip; the owner's dev server on port 3000 keeps running untouched during `npm run test:e2e`
the CI e2e job still passes with the same command (`npm run test:e2e`)
docs/development-workflow.md end-to-end section and the Learnings line about port 3000 in ralph/progress.md are updated
tasks.notes: Until this task is done, iterations must not run `npm run test:e2e`: the current config builds into `.next` and reuses whatever answers on port 3000, which is the owner's dev server.
